visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard and mustache, wearing a blue baseball cap and a dark denim jumpsuit, stands in front of a beige curtain background. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a bedroom where the man stands over a large bed. He begins to manipulate a thick grey and white comforter, laying it out flat and starting a specialized military-style folding technique known as 'tofu folding.' (3) He continues the folding process with high precision, using his hands and forearms to press the fabric and create sharp edges. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the bedding. (4) The man gets onto his knees on the mattress to better reach the far side of the comforter, meticulously smoothing out wrinkles and checking the alignment of the folds. (5) A different perspective shows him focusing on a corner, using a watch-wearing hand to tuck in the material. Another person's hand briefly enters the frame to point out a small imperfection in the fold. (6) The man reacts with mock frustration, picks up the entire folded comforter, and walks into a modern laundry room. He demonstrates its durability by throwing it into a front-loading washing machine and holding a bottle of detergent.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a machine-washable comforter by using the humorous and relatable concept of military 'tofu folding,' showcasing the product's texture and easy maintenance.
